title: Daily News Quiz · 2026-08-31
headline: Spirulina grown under special light makes active vitamin B12 like beef

questions.prompt: What did the special light help the Spirulina produce?

hintI18n.de: Die Lichtänderung betraf Vitamine in Algen, nicht Geld oder Maschinen.
hintI18n.vi: Sự thay đổi ánh sáng liên quan đến vitamin trong tảo, không phải tiền hay máy móc.

hintI18n.id: Perubahan cahaya itu tentang vitamin pada alga, bukan uang atau mesin.

hintI18n.pl: Zmiana światła dotyczyła witamin w algach, a nie pieniędzy czy maszyn.

They want a new sports drink
